title: Halloween weekend is here
blurb: Costumes on, Three Village. The Long Island Museum throws a free Halloween Family Fun Day on Sunday, there are two trunk or treats on Saturday, and it's the last weekend to vote for your favorite Stony Brook Village scarecrow.
short: A free family fun day at the Long Island Museum, two trunk or treats and the last weekend to vote for the Stony Brook Village scarecrows.
bullets_short: Sun 1-4 PM: Halloween Family Fun Day at the Long Island Museum, free: come in costume for pumpkin painting, crafts and a Mad Science show (bring a food donation for Agape Meals for Kids)
Sat 12-4 PM: Spooktacular Trunk or Treat & Vendor Fair at Messiah Lutheran Church, East Setauket, with free face painting
All weekend: vote for your favorite Stony Brook Village scarecrow (ballots in every shop through Sunday), plus every Halloween event in town on our Halloween page
